alloy.preparation: 304L (UNS S30403). Obtained commercially in sheet and/or rod form. Flat, circular-flat or cylindrical specimens were used without any further heat treatment (Materials, PDF p. 3).

test_solution.preparation: Chloride-containing aqueous solution prepared by dissolving analytical-grade NaCl in distilled water and then adjusting pH to 7.8 by adding NaOH (Materials, PDF p. 3).

test_method.procedure_description: Potentiodynamic polarization at 50 °C using circular-flat or cylindrical working specimens screwed into a sample holder, with an exposed area of 1 cm^2 (PDF p. 3). The paper's 'All the experiments' corrosion-cell statement reports a saturated calomel reference electrode with a potassium chloride salt bridge and graphite counter electrodes (EG and G Model K 0047, PDF p. 4). Pitting-specific scan rate, scan limits and stabilization time are not supplied; detailed potentiodynamic/polarization-resistance setups are referred to an earlier publication on PDF p. 3. Chloride-containing aqueous medium with 300 ppm Cl- (Table 5).
test_method.pitting_criterion: The potential at which a consistent increase in current density occurs, indicating initiation of non-passivating pits (Potentiodynamic polarization measurements, PDF p. 6).
